entry_authority.intervening_scope: Stage33 V91B only; no Stage36, locked Stage29 sign-cover, Arsenal, or Research OS source used here changed

second_conic.coverage_note: the omitted d+v=0 case forces a=0 and is outside the physical open locus

exact_four_factor_reduction.equivalence: B*C is a rational square iff F1*F2*F3*F4 is a rational square

primitive_denominator_clearing.equivalence: the receiver product-square condition is equivalent to N1*N2*N3*N4 being an integer square

unbounded_shared_odd_prime_support.statement: for every prime p congruent to 1 mod 4 there are primitive admissible P,Q,R,S for which v_p(N1)=v_p(N2)=1 and v_p(N3)=v_p(N4)=0
construction: choose h with h^2 congruent -1 mod p but h^2 not congruent -1 mod p^2; write h^2=-1+p*alpha mod p^2 with alpha nonzero mod p
choose m mod p with m nonzero and m not congruent plus-or-minus alpha/2 mod p
unbounded_shared_odd_prime_support.primitive_and_physical_checks: gcd(P,Q)=gcd(R,S)=1; P,Q,R,S are nonzero; for p>=5 the exclusions q=plus-or-minus1 and r=0,plus-or-minus1 are avoided by the construction

valuation_proof_mod_p2.N1: N1 congruent p*(alpha-2*m) mod p^2, hence v_p(N1)=1
valuation_proof_mod_p2.N2: N2 congruent p*(alpha+2*m) mod p^2, hence v_p(N2)=1
valuation_proof_mod_p2.N3: N3 congruent -4 mod p, hence v_p(N3)=0
valuation_proof_mod_p2.N4: N4 congruent 4 mod p, hence v_p(N4)=0

unbounded_shared_odd_prime_support.parity_compatibility: the total p-adic valuation of N1*N2*N3*N4 is even at such a prime, so the product-square parity condition does not remove this shared prime
unbounded_shared_odd_prime_support.scope_firewall: this is a local valuation-support construction, not a global rational point on the common-Jminus receiver

S34_W01_preflight.reason_pairwise_support_fails: arbitrarily large primes p congruent 1 mod 4 can occur with odd valuation simultaneously in N1 and N2 and nowhere in N3,N4
S34_W01_preflight.firewall: the four-factor shape is useful exact structure, but same factor shape does not supply the Stage34 finite squareclass theorem

route_decision.blocker: the selected S34-W01 first-layer descent cannot produce a finite fixed squareclass branch family from N1*N2*N3*N4 because variable odd shared-prime support survives local product parity
route_decision.reentry_condition: a genuinely new normalization or extra receiver condition must eliminate or finitely control the arbitrary (1,1,0,0) odd-prime support before S34-W01 can be retried
